name: Ninja Block | v0.2
author: m_vishuu
description:
Ninja Block - An endless platformer minigame | Do you have what it takes to be a Ninja? Show your skills in this fast paced and frustrating game where you play as a Ninja who is being attacked by enemy Rogue Ninjas. How long can you withstand their attacks? Share your High Scores by taking a snapshot and uploading it in the comments. Added: new movement mechanics and sound effects and better collision detection. Controls:                                        Arrow Keys/A-D -> Move                                                                                                          Space -> Jump                                  
Long Press Space -> High Jump
